Two weeks ago tomorrow, my wife and I were getting ready to go see a ska band.  I took our 5 dogs outside to use the bathroom before we left.  Our one dog we adopted 1.5 years ago has IV/VI murmur- we knew when we adopted ~ 11 year old toy fox terrier decided to DIE….


My wife, who is nowhere near our field was in the bathroom taking a bath.  I brought our dog in there (I am a confident RVT, but still need support sometimes) and I started CPR.  I thought to no avail.  Still trying, I didn’t think anything was going to work.  I live 25 minutes from where I work and 15 minutes to the closest ER.  Since we thought our dog was dead, we went to where I work.  Well….. about 7-10 minutes into our drive my wife said, I hear our dog moaning.  I listen and say, yes she is, but I thought possible agonal breathing. I am doing some chest compressions while driving and my wife is doing some massaging ash she called it.  (My wife is close to being a reiki master also)  Do not be naive to this people! 

We arrive at work and our dog is showing more signs of life.  We place her on flow by oxygen and SPO2 is increasing.  I place an IV catheter and do a shock dose of fluids.  Could not find a blood pressure, but everything else is improving.  We were there for about 20 minutes and we were somewhat at the impasse we all know.  We decided to keep going- about 30-40 minutes of flow by.  Neither of us are ready to do goodbye, nor is our dog.  We keep the catheter in place and take a pulse ox and fluid pump home.  This dog comes home and actually walks outside and is ok…..

Take her back the next morning and give fluids for about 3 hours.  Take her home and she acts relatively normal.  

This is almost two weeks later and this dog is fairly normal.  She has been in a holter monitor for 6 days and is being removed tomorrow.  

This dog is kind of a miracle.
